_notes: Faction doctrine profiles (Captain, P0164 queue 17 part 6; every number proposed, for Captain's playtests). Each biases decisions the squad AI already makes (SquadAI, Doctrine): engage_m how far out it picks targets (m); reaction a factor on the time to the first shot at a new target; aim_deg degrees of aim error added; burst a factor on burst length and burst_pause on the pause between bursts (suppressive fire volume); cover_fire_s how long after the last sight of the enemy it keeps putting covering fire on where they were; frag_cooldown_s seconds between one unit's frags, frag_wait_s how long an enemy must stay hidden or behind cover before a frag goes in; morale_shaken and morale_broken the morale under which aim suffers and under which it falls back (or may give up); advance_after_s how long a hostile waits without sight before pushing a bound toward the enemy, and flank (0..1) how far to the side that bound goes. 'sides' gives each side's doctrine when none is set on the squad or the unit; hostiles follow their zone's people ('nations', by Names nation; 'hostile' when the nation isn't listed).
